executivePulse.interpretation: The situation in memory and AI infrastructure remains strained. Server DRAM/RDIMM, HBM and enterprise SSDs are currently among the tightest segments. The Daily Check of 2026-08-26 reviewed eight current relevant reports; it does not indicate any confirmed material directional change. New capacity and improved yields can relieve pressure, but will reach the market only with a time lag. For buyers, supply assurance, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
